name: Bulk Email Checker API
description:
A low-latency RESTful API for real-time email address verification. Performs 17+ factor validation including RFC syntax checks, DNS/MX record verification, disposable email detection, spam trap screening, role account detection, catch-all server identification, anti-greylisting, and a full SMTP handshake to confirm mailbox existence. Returns rich MX enrichment data with every request. Credits are consumed only for passed and failed results; unknown results are free.

**Rate Limits by Account Tier:**
| Tier | Hourly Quota | Max Concurrent Threads |
|---|---|---|
| Standard (< 1M Credits) | 1,500 req/hr | 1 |
| Volume Tier 1 (1M+ Credits) | 2,500 req/hr | 3 |
| Volume Tier 2 (10M+ Credits) | 4,000 req/hr | 5 |

For unlimited throughput, see the [Unlimited API](https://bulkemailchecker.com/unlimited-email-verification-api-pricing/).
